title: SPTS-JM-BANK: directly addressed measured records with linear classical space

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE physical SPTS-JM-BANK interpreter in proof.md executes the complete virtual SPTS-JM program in joint-source.md and its unchanged included SPTS/RQ mathematical sources. The fixed original joint bank may have any allowed good/bad/reference entanglement, with at most floor(Q/3) bad positions and the exact product good marginal. Passive fixed-order delivery and arbitrary conditional unread states are included. The full correlated-CQ invariant includes unread original systems, so full output law equals V and unconditional entire-secret success is strictly greater than11/16, including the clean case and finite n<64/n=1 branches. Every mutable classical V record, generator/allocator/stack/descriptor and its padding is in a counted computational-basis quantum bank, with only input/output and O(log^2(n+2)) staging classical. The entire paired prefix is counted; known addressed READ/WRITE, field fetch, actual bit/gate generation, source fees and SWAPs, all failed work, original guards, initialization and output-first complete cleanup are paid. The direct-address interpreter costs O(log^3(n+2)) charged work per original bit primitive, not a free or arbitrary polynomial simulation. No quantum-addressed bank, coherent classical lookup, source inverse/control, supplied purification or arbitrary rotation primitive is used. All five guarantees hold JOINTLY on EVERY branch for this SAME physical implementation. Charged physical time is O(2^((1/2)n)n(log2n)^6), exact growth index1. This includes the separately paid interpreter overhead; virtual log-cubed time is not asserted as physical time.

structured.error_model: Among the Q acquired copies, an adversary fixes a set B of at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed positions, possibly depending on N and s. The joint state is arbitrary subject to its reduced state on all other positions being exactly rho_s^{tensor (Q-|B|)}. Malformed systems may be correlated or entangled with each other and with other systems subject to that marginal promise. No source control, purification access, or preparation inverse is supplied.
